author: JokerUK
quote: Pretty to look at, miserable to playWe waited 13 years for this and honestly I’m so disappointed. Yeah the graphics are crazy good and Vice City looks amazing, but Rockstar forgot that a game is actually supposed to be fun.First off, it runs at 30 fps in 2026 which feels super choppy as soon as anything happens on screen. The controls are still clunky as hell too. Half the time I try to reload or open a trunk and my character just stands there or accidentally kicks someone because all the buttons do five different things.They tried way too hard to make it realistic and it ruins the whole point of GTA. If you crash your car at high speed it basically breaks instantly, so you cant even drive fast without having to get a new ride every two minutes. And the cops are just annoying now. Because they remember your clothesk and license plate, getting away feels like a chore instead of an actual fun **** story takes forever to get going and makes you do boring chores and relationship stuff, and if you walk two feet away from where a mission wants you to go it just fails you. Even the top half of the map feels completely empty and you have to pay 100 bucks just to fast travel. Add in a bunch of bugs that literally deleted some of my progress and I just cant recommend it. Total letdown.
